rooms.24600: The crevice splits the mountainside into two cold walls of dark rock, so narrow that your shoulders brush stone on either hand. Bone-white lichen crusts the cracks, and a thin wind whistles through carrying a smell of smoke and old blood. The way west opens back onto the path by the tall tower wall, while to the north a door woven of black thorn and hung with knotted cords stands ajar on the thicket.
rooms.24601: You stand where the crevice gives way to the entrance of the Manigua Thicket, a green mouth of knotted briar and twisted trunks. Pale cords strung with bird skulls sway from the lowest boughs and click softly in the breeze. Narrow tunnels of leaves lead north, east and west into the thicket, and the thorn door south leads back to the crevice.
rooms.24602: Thorned branches knit overhead so tightly that the daylight comes down green and broken. The ground is a mat of rotted leaves, scored with the deep gouges of tusks. Every way you turn looks the same, a wall of briar and bent trunks, and somewhere close a branch snaps and goes still.
rooms.24603: A fallen oak lies rotting across the thicket here, its bark stripped and stained brown with something that is not sap. Brambles have grown up through the split trunk and hook at your cloak whenever you shift your weight. The air is thick and sweetish, and the faint beat of a far drum seems to travel through the roots.
rooms.24604: The briars part into a low hollow where the earth is trampled flat and ringed with small cairns of river stones. Strips of faded red cloth hang from the thorns, each one knotted by a careful hand. Moss on the nearest stones is black and crusted, and a cold breath stirs the leaves though no wind reaches this deep.
rooms.24605: Slender spears of light find their way through the canopy and pick out a web as wide as a cart wheel strung between two trunks. It is hung with the dry husks of small beasts, turning slowly. Thorns the length of a finger rake the air on every side, and the ground squelches softly underfoot.
rooms.24606: A rutted game trail winds through the thickest part of the Manigua, so low that you must stoop beneath the arching canes. Fresh mud is churned along it, and the bark of the nearby trunks is rubbed raw to the height of your hip. A humming you feel more than hear rises from the earth, as if great stones lay buried close by.
rooms.24607: A broad flat of trampled grass opens before a ring of grey monoliths, each taller than three men and cut with spiral grooves. No matter which way you turn, north, east, south, west, up or down, the only road is through the Stone Portal. The stones hum low and steady, and the grass at their feet is stained a rusty brown.
rooms.24612: The Stone Portal is a gateway of two vast uprights capped by a lintel, black with old smoke and slick with a greasy sheen. Rust-red handprints climb the pillars as high as a man could reach. A paved avenue leads west into the stone city, while a trodden strip of grass to the north curls round and returns to the portal. Drums pulse faintly through the soles of your boots.
rooms.24613: A wide avenue of grey flagstones runs west between rows of squat stone houses, their doorways hung with hides and strings of bone. The paving is dished by countless feet and stained dark in long channels along the gutters. Ahead, the avenue ends at a low, broad rock, and a heavy smell of copper drifts back along it.
rooms.24614: The Slaughter Stone squats here, a waist-high slab of black rock with a shallow bowl worn in its top and grooves running to its edges. Long years of sacrifice have turned the ground around it to a hard crust the colour of rust. Iron rings are set into its flanks. The avenue lies back to the east, and the great ring of the circle begins to the north.
rooms.24615: Here the great ring begins: a curve of standing stones, each carved with a face whose mouth hangs open as if caught mid-scream. Dried herbs and ragged feathers are tied about their bases. The path runs north along the inside of the circle, and the Slaughter Stone lies a few paces south, still reeking of old sacrifice.
rooms.24616: The stones here lean slightly inward, as if listening, their flanks scabbed with yellow lichen. A drainage groove cut into the path carries a thin dark trickle toward the Slaughter Stone. Chimes of knuckle and rib hang from a crossbar between two uprights and knock together in the draught. The path goes on north around the circle and back south toward its beginning.
rooms.24617: A drum frame of lashed antlers stands against the inner edge of the path, its skin head stretched taut and dyed with red palm prints. It is silent now, but the stone beside it still seems to tremble. Weeds grow in the cracks of the paving, and the track runs on north and south around the ring.
rooms.24618: Two standing stones lean together here to make a crooked arch, and the ground beneath is bare and packed hard as a threshing floor. Scratched into the lower stone are tally marks in rows, hundreds upon hundreds. The circle bends sharply ahead to the north, and the way south runs back along the ring.
rooms.24619: The circle turns sharply here, the path hugging a stone so broad that it throws a deep shadow well into the day. A smaller track breaks off west toward the First Altar Of The Stones, and the way south follows the ring back. Long scars mark the great stone, as though something once clawed or chained itself against it.
rooms.24620: The First Altar is a low table of rough rock, the top hollowed and crusted with dried black offerings. Bundles of thorn and bleached bone lie heaped at its foot, and the air is heavy with the sour reek of burnt fat. The stones around it hum, a low note that settles in your teeth. The only way out is north, back to the bend in the circle.
rooms.24621: The path swings around a corner stone carved with a coiling serpent whose scales are worn smooth by passing hands. A short track dips south to the First Altar Of The Stones. The circle continues west, and a cold draught comes along it smelling of wet earth and woodsmoke.
rooms.24622: Flat paving slabs lie here in a neat row, each cut with a spiral from edge to centre and rubbed dark in the middle. Flecks of straw and dried blood cling to the seams between them. Tall stones stand on either side of the path, which runs east and west along the ring.
rooms.24623: The ground rises a little on a low bank of turf, and the stones above it wear collars of rope hung with small clay faces. A soot-black stain streaks down the nearest upright from a hollow near its crown. Wind sighs through the gaps between the stones as the way runs east and west.
rooms.24624: Ahead, the ground dips toward a squat building of heaped slabs, and the air grows closer and ranker. Piles of antlers and split bones lie by the roadside, bleached by the weather. The path east follows the ring, while the way west leads into the Pit Stones.
rooms.24625: Massive slabs have been leaned together to roof a long, low hall, and the air inside is cold, close and smelling of old straw. Torches of pitch-soaked reed smoulder in iron brackets, laying a red light on the rough walls. Deep scratches score the floor, which slopes gently toward the west. The way east leads out to the circle.
rooms.24626: In the middle of the Pit Stones the floor falls away into a shallow trough ringed with stout posts, the hard earth packed with old blood and sawdust. Smoky torches burn along the walls, and the shadows of the posts crawl across the roof slabs. Passages lead east and west through the hall, and a heavy door of dark wood stands in the north wall.
rooms.24627: The High Priest's quarters are a wide room of dressed stone hung with tanned hides and trophies of horn and tooth. A great bed of furs fills one corner, and a fire pit glows red in the middle of the floor. Doors of iron-bound oak open east to a vault and west to a dark office, and the way south returns to the pit hall. A curtained archway on the north side only loops back into the same room.
rooms.24628: The vault is a squat chamber of fitted stone, its ceiling so low that you stoop to enter. Iron-banded chests, long since smashed open and emptied, line the walls, and the dust holds the ghost-shapes of a vanished hoard. A single dry brazier hangs from a chain. The only way out is west, back to the priest's quarters.
rooms.24629: Narrow slits let in almost no light, and the office stays dim even at noon. Shelves of clay tablets and knotted record-cords climb the walls, and a table of black stone is scored with columns of accounts in a cramped hand. A cold smell of tallow and old ink clings to everything. The only door leads east to the High Priest's quarters.
rooms.24630: At this end of the Pit Stones the roof slabs rise higher, and a grey light creeps in from the way west, where the hall opens onto the ring. Piles of knucklebones and broken clay cups lie in the corners, and a rank smell of sweat and straw hangs about. The trough floor lies back to the east.
rooms.24631: A fire-blackened stone stands beside the path with a ring of ash at its foot, still faintly warm. Strings of wolf teeth are tied to a post by the track and rattle with every gust. The low hall of the Pit Stones lies east, and the way west leads to a turn in the circle.
rooms.24632: The ring turns here at a stone split down the middle by lightning, its two halves blackened and leaning apart. Beneath it a path leads south to the Second Altar Of The Stones, and the circle runs back east. Charred splinters lie scattered across the beaten earth, and the smell of scorched rock lingers.
rooms.24633: The Second Altar is a drum-shaped block of stone, its sides carved with lines of kneeling figures bearing bowls. The top is stained in dark rings, one atop another, like the growth of a tree. Rags and braided hair are knotted about its posts, and the air hums sharply. The only path leads west back to the bend.
rooms.24634: The path bends around a squat boulder shaped like a hunched old man, its face worn almost away. East, a short track leads to the Second Altar Of The Stones, and the ring carries on south. Dry thistles rattle in the cracks of the paving, and the hum of the stones is thin and high.
rooms.24635: A horned skull the size of a cart wheel is mounted on a pole beside the path, its eye sockets packed with red clay. Beyond it the stones stand in a crooked row, their tops furred with moss. The path runs north to a bend and south along the ring.
rooms.24636: Rain has pooled in the ruts of the path, and the water has a rusty tint where it laps the paving. A tall stone beside it is pitted with hollows where the hands of worshippers have pressed. The ring runs north and south, and the air hums faintly around the monoliths.
rooms.24637: A standing stone lies toppled across the verge, half buried in nettles, and the others seem to crowd closer to fill the gap. Its underside, turned up to the light, is covered with carved spirals gone green with moss. The circle path continues north and south, packed hard by generations of feet.
rooms.24638: Rows of tiny cairns, no bigger than a fist, line both edges of the path, each topped with a single tooth or chip of bone. Between them the grass has been trodden away by slow processions. The stones loom close on one hand, and the path leads north and south around the ring.
rooms.24639: A flat stone the size of a cart bed has been laid over a round hole in the path, and a sour, cold air breathes from the gaps around it. Iron staples hold it down, rusted red. The way runs north and south, and the nearby stones hum at a deeper pitch than elsewhere.
rooms.24640: Tattered banners of tanned hide hang from the uprights here, painted with crude suns, serpents and open hands. They snap in the wind, rattling the bone beads sewn along their hems. The path leads north around the ring and south to a sharp bend.
rooms.24641: The circle makes a sharp turn at a stone wrapped in a collar of red-dyed wool. A narrow track leads east to the Third Altar Of The Stones, and the ring runs back north. The ground is pocked with the holes of old stakes, and an iron smell lingers in the air.
rooms.24642: The Third Altar rises on three steps of rough stone, its top flat and scorched black by fires lit upon it. Ladders of chain hang from a wooden frame at its side, rusted and crusted with something dark. The humming here is almost a voice. The only way out is south, to the bend in the circle.
rooms.24643: The path turns past a corner stone wrapped in a rope of dried vines, hung with little bundles of hair. A short track climbs north to the Third Altar Of The Stones, and the circle runs on east. The ground is hard and pale, scuffed by generations of dancing feet.
rooms.24644: Eyes have been carved into the face of the nearest standing stone, dozens of them in staring rows, each rimmed with red ochre. It is easy to feel watched here. The circle path runs east and west, bordered by clumps of thistle.
rooms.24645: A row of sharpened stakes, grey with age, stands along the edge of the path, each topped with a rag of cloth. The stones behind them are black with smoke, and the ground between is scattered with trodden embers. The way leads east and west around the ring.
rooms.24646: Here the path meets two doors set into squat stone buildings that crowd the inner side of the ring, one to the north and one to the south, each framed by a massive carved lintel. The north door is stamped with signs of flame, wave, wind and rock. The ring runs on east and west, and the pavement underfoot is cleaner swept than elsewhere.
rooms.24689: Four bowls of different stone stand in the corners of this round chamber, one holding a low flame, one dark water, one pale grit and one a coil of drifting smoke. The ceiling is domed and the walls are painted with swirling bands of colour. The air is oddly still and smells of rain and hot metal. The only door leads south.
rooms.24647: The path passes two doors here, the one to the north painted white and the one to the south painted black, both bearing alchemical signs in silver and soot. Between them the pavement is stained with spilled reagents in every colour. The ring leads east and west, and a sharp, bitter fume hangs on the air.
rooms.24692: The chamber is scrubbed and pale, with shelves of glass flasks, clay jars and wax-sealed pots lining the walls. A long bench of white stone holds a still, its coils green with verdigris. The air smells of vinegar and clean linen. The only way out is south.
rooms.24648: Two iron-studded doors face each other across the path here, one on the north side and one on the south, each with a narrow grille at head height. Scratches mark the stone about the frames, and a stale smell of old straw and sweat seeps through. The ring runs on east to a bend and west along the path.

24694.description: A stone passage runs between low barred doors, each hiding a bare cell with a heap of rotten straw. Chains hang from rings in the walls, and the floor drains toward a central gutter that runs foul. Torchlight barely reaches the end, where a door leads north to the Chief Guard's Office. The way south returns to the circle.

rooms.24683: A broad desk of scarred oak fills most of this cramped office, its top cut with knife marks and ringed by the stains of many mugs. Keys hang on a board by the door, and a rack of spiked clubs leans against the wall. The air is warm and smells of leather and tallow. A passage leads east to the Guards Hall, and a door south opens on the cell block.
rooms.24684: Long trestle tables run the length of this stone hall, scarred by dice and daggers, with benches worn smooth by years of sitting. A hearth at one end holds a heap of cold ash, and spears are racked along the wall under cheap tallow lamps. A door leads west to the Chief Guard's Office, and the way south opens onto the Golden Fountain.
rooms.24681: The Golden Fountain rises from a ring of cracked paving, a basin of gilded stone whose spout is carved as a roaring mouth. The water that pours from it is murky and tinged red. A door in the north leads into the Guards Hall, an arched entrance lies west, a corner of the plaza spreads east, and the Plaza itself opens south.
rooms.24680: The plaza turns here in a neat corner marked by a squat pillar, its top carved with a grinning sun. Weeds push up between the flagstones, and the wind carries a smell of woodsmoke and roasting meat. Open ground lies back west toward the Golden Fountain, and the paving runs south to another corner.
rooms.24679: At this corner of the plaza a rank of low stone benches faces inward, their seats black with old grease. A pole painted in red and white bands rises from the paving, its tip hung with a tangle of feathers. The way north follows the edge of the plaza, and the way west leads on into the open Plaza.
rooms.24678: The paving of the plaza is cut with great concentric rings, and in the shallow grooves between them dark stains have gathered. Stunted weeds grow where the stones have heaved. The Golden Fountain splashes to the north, more rings stretch west across the Plaza, and a corner lies east.
rooms.24676: This part of the plaza is dominated by a squat platform of scorched stone, blackened at the edges where fires have been lit. Smoke-stained pillars stand about the open ground. An arched entrance rises to the north, the plaza continues east, and a lane leads south into the City Of Sacrifice.
rooms.24682: A tall arch of dark stone spans the way here, carved with writhing vines and open mouths. A door of heavy planks stands to the west, and beyond it you can glimpse a ring of altars. The murmur of the Golden Fountain comes from the east, and the plaza lies south.
rooms.24685: Stone altars stand in a ring about a shallow sunken court, each carved with a different beast's head. The floor is polished by years of bare feet, and the air is thick with incense. The Silver Altar lies north, the Golden Altar south, a dark tunnel opens west, and the arched entrance lies back east.
rooms.24686: The Silver Altar is a block of pale stone sheathed in tarnished plates of silver, beaten with wolf and moon patterns. Dried sprigs of mistletoe lie scattered across its top, and the ground is stained with old libations. The only way out is south, to the circle of altars.
rooms.24687: The Golden Altar glints dully, its top plated with a thin leaf of gold that peels from the stone in curls. Horns and ribs are bound with red cords at its corners, and a heavy sweetness hangs in the air. The way out lies north, to the circle of altars.
rooms.24699: The tunnel is hewn through the heart of the altar stones, so low that you must stoop, and its walls are slick with damp. Handholds and tallow stubs mark where generations of priests have passed. The passage leads west toward a pale glow.
rooms.24688: The Grand Stone of Jostoricath stands in a ring of bare earth, a monolith twice the height of any other, its surface covered in writhing glyphs that seem to gleam when you look away. The ground around it is polished pale as bone. The hum that runs through the whole circle seems to rise from here, and the air tastes of metal.
rooms.24674: Narrow lanes of fitted stone wind between low walls blackened by smoke, the gutters running dark. Hides are pegged out to dry on frames beside the doorways. The Plaza lies north, a low opening leads east into the Burrow In The Altar, and the lane goes on south as a path.
rooms.24675: A cramped hollow lies in the side of a huge altar block, lined with matted straw and furs where someone has long made a bed. The walls are smooth and cold, and the smell is musty, of damp fur and old meat. The only way out is west.
rooms.24673: A paved path runs here with ditches on either side, each choked with trampled reeds and fallen branches. Poles topped with skulls mark its edges and lean at drunken angles. The city lies north, and the path goes on west.
rooms.24672: The path squeezes between two blocks of stone so close that they brush your sleeves, then widens again. Red ochre has been smeared on both walls at head height in broad sweeps. The path leads east, while west it ends at the great mass of the Great Stone.
rooms.24671: You stand in a great hollow within the Great Stone, a passage lit only by what spills in from the path, its walls carved with long processions of figures bearing burdens. The air is cool and still, and the hum of the stone is almost unbearable here. The path lies back east, and the Great Altar Of The Eclipse waits west.
rooms.24670: A vast round altar of black stone fills this chamber, its top inlaid with a disc of polished black glass that gives back no reflection. Pale scratches crowd the floor around it in long arcs. A door leads east to the Great Stone, and the way north leads on to the Altar Of Arms.
rooms.24669: Rusted blades, cracked shields and broken spears are set in rows upon this long altar, offerings from battles fought and lost long ago. The stone beneath them is stained a deep brown. The Great Altar Of The Eclipse lies to the south, and a narrower way leads west to the Altar Of Power.
rooms.24668: The Altar Of Power is a high seat hewn from a single block, with arms carved as the coiled bodies of serpents. A ring of broad steps surrounds it, worn hollow at the centre. Cold light falls from a gap in the sky above, and the air hums like a plucked string. A way leads north into the stone city, and another east to the Altar Of Arms.
rooms.24667: Tall slabs of weathered stone line a broad lane here, each one carved with a hunched, wide-mouthed face. The ground is hard, dark and pocked with the marks of heavy feet. The lane runs north deeper into the stone city, and south toward the Altar Of Power.
rooms.24666: The lane narrows between two high slabs, so that only a thin strip of sky shows overhead. Strands of dried gut are hung between the stones, rattling like old chimes. The lane leads north to a turn in the circle, and south into the stone city.
rooms.24665: A sharp bend turns the stone circle, the path pressed between a huge corner stone and a ditch grown with tall grass. The corner stone is carved with the figure of a kneeling woman, her arms raised as if in pleading. A track leads east to the Altar of Zacchariath, and the lane south returns to the stone city.
rooms.24664: The Altar of Zacchariath is a squat stone table veined with red, flanked by two pillars crowned with ram's horns. Black candle stubs crust its edges, and a ladder of notches is cut down one side, one for each offering made. The hum of the stone is slow and heavy here. A path leads north to a bend in the circle, and another west to the lane at the corner stone.
rooms.24663: The circle bends here around a stone with a deep bowl hollowed in its crown, a small pool of rainwater trembling in it. Handfuls of grain and withered flowers lie scattered at its foot. The track runs east along the ring, and a short way south lies the Altar of Zacchariath.
rooms.24662: A long cord strung between two uprights holds a row of dried gourds, hollow and rattling with seeds, that clack together in the wind. The path below is polished by bare feet and ringed with the pale scuffs of dancers. The ring of stones runs east and west.
rooms.24661: Faces are carved along the lower flanks of the stones here, each a flat grinning mask with sunken eyes, and a few have been daubed with fresh red paint. Dust lies thick in the creases, and a cold, scratching draught moves between the monoliths. The path runs east and west along the ring.
rooms.24660: The turf beside the path has been trodden into a perfect circle, bare and hard, where some great dance must be held at night. Stakes at its edge bear faded streamers, and the ground rings faintly underfoot. The ring path goes on east and west.
rooms.24659: A broad stone stands at the path's edge, plastered with the dry mud of many hands and sprouting small ferns from its crevices. A pair of bone flutes, long and thin, hang from a thong at its side, swaying and whistling. The path runs west along the ring, and east it bends sharply.
rooms.24658: The ring bends sharply at a tall corner stone crowned with a skull of some great horned beast, its sockets filled with moss. South, a short track leads to the Altar Of Hydroglix, and the circle continues west. The grass here is flattened in long strips, as though heavy sledges have been dragged across it.
rooms.24657: The Altar Of Hydroglix is a ring of blue-green stone around a shallow basin, its rim carved with rippling waves and the long, whiskered faces of river spirits. The basin holds a stagnant, still pool, covered with a skin of green. A path leads north to a bend in the circle and another east along the ring.
rooms.24656: The circle swings round a corner stone stained green along its lower half, as if it stood often in water. The path drops a little here, and the earth is soft and cold. A track leads west to the Altar Of Hydroglix, and the way south follows the ring.
rooms.24655: Thick white roots, thin as ropes, have forced up the paving here and broken it into tilted plates. The stones on both sides lean outward, giving the path a cramped, tunnelled feel. The ring runs north to a bend and south along the circle.
rooms.24654: Hung from a gibbet of lashed timber beside the path is an empty iron cage, its door open and its bars worn bright where hands have gripped them. The stones beyond it are blackened at their feet by long-dead fires. The path runs north and south around the ring.
rooms.24653: A weathered monolith here is crowned with a ring of ragged rope and shells, and the path at its foot is strewn with broken pottery. Sherds crunch underfoot as the track continues north and south along the circle. The humming of the stones rises and falls like breathing.
rooms.24652: A tall pole stands in the verge of the path, hung with the dry, curling skins of long-dead beasts and topped with a rack of antlers. The wind sets the skins clapping like a distant crowd. The way runs north along the ring and south to a sharp bend.
rooms.24651: The circle bends sharply around a stone cut with a great sunburst, its rays picked out in ochre that still glows in the light. A flight of steps leads west to the Altar Of The Sun, and the ring runs north. The paving is warm and dry, and a smell of burnt herbs lingers.
rooms.24650: The Altar Of The Sun is a wide disc of yellow stone set flat in the earth, its surface carved with rays and rimmed with gutters stained dark. A stout post stands at its centre, black with old burns. The paving is warm underfoot. Paths lead east to the bend of the circle and south to another turn.
rooms.24649: The ring turns again here beside a lopsided stone that tilts over the path like a bowed head. Burnt-down sticks of incense are stuck in every crack, and soot streaks the rock above. The Altar Of The Sun lies north, and the circle runs on west.

24695.description: A short passage between barred cell doors, each hiding a bare cell with a heap of rotten straw. Iron rings in the walls still hold lengths of rusted chain, and a cracked bucket stinks in a corner. The torchlight is low and yellow. The only way out is north, back to the circle.

rooms.24693: The black-walled chamber is crowded with crooked shelves of stoppered bottles, bones and dried roots, and a smoky lamp throws long, crawling shadows. A table of dark stone is stained in many colours, and a sticky residue thickens the floor. The air burns the nose. The only way out is north.
rooms.24691: A round chamber with a domed ceiling painted gold, and a great sun disc set in the floor, ringed with spokes of inlaid brass. The walls are hung with faded yellow banners, and the air is warm and dry as a summer noon. A dull light seems to come from the ceiling itself. The only door leads north.
rooms.24608: The thicket is at its densest here, the trunks so close that the way is a crawl under dripping boughs. Cobwebs bind the branches together, and the leaf litter is deep, soft and pale with fungus. A trail of crushed bracken leads onward toward a lighter patch of ground.
rooms.24609: The thicket opens into a small clearing of bare, churned earth, ringed with piles of gnawed bones and rough brush walls. In its centre a hole yawns, its edges worn smooth by a heavy body, and a hot, rank breath rises from it. The way east leads back into the thicket, and a steep passage descends into the dark.

24610.description: The beast's lair is a low, ragged cavity in the rock, its floor strewn with broken bones and wads of matted fur. The stone walls are rubbed smooth and glossy by a huge body passing to and fro, and a sour musk fills the air. A rough passage climbs up to the clearing in the thicket, and another leads down toward the Stone Portal.

24614.description: The black slab is hollowed like a basin, and the grooves in it run to a notch on the lowest edge. The iron rings are polished bright on the inside where ropes and chains have rubbed them.

24618.description: Row on row of short strokes, scratched with a flint and grouped in fives. Whoever kept the count never finished it.

24632.description: The stone is cleft from crown to root, and the heart of it is glassy where the fire passed through. Priests say the sky itself once struck here in anger.

24644.description: No two of the carved eyes are alike. Some weep grooves of red, and some are crossed out with a single hard stroke.

24639.description: The slab is held down with six iron staples, and a pale scratch along one edge shows where someone has tried to prise it up.

24688.description: The glyphs crawl in tight, interlocking lines, and your eye keeps losing its place among them. One symbol, a wide-open eye, recurs near the top.

24670.description: The disc is flawless and cold to the touch. Its surface shows only the dark, and the faint outline of your own hand against it.

24650.description: The carved rays run out from the central post like the spokes of a wheel. Each gutter ends in a notch at the disc's edge, as if to let something drain away.

creatures.long_desc: A bristling thicket boar snorts and paws at the leaf litter, its tusks stained dark.
creatures.description: This boar is as big as a pony, its coat a mat of thorns and dried mud. Its tusks are yellow and curved, and one is notched from fighting in the briars.

creatures.long_desc: A thorn-backed spider hangs motionless in its web, watching with a ring of dull eyes.
creatures.description: A spider as broad as a shield, its long legs bristling with barbs like the briars it lives among. Its pale belly is mottled with rust red.

creatures.long_desc: A red-painted cultist stands muttering in the shadow of a standing stone, a bone knife in his hand.
creatures.description: A lean, wild-eyed worshipper with his skin smeared in red and white clay. He wears a kilt of hide and a necklace of knucklebones.

creatures.long_desc: A scarred cell guard keeps watch here, a spiked club slung over one shoulder.
creatures.description: A thick-necked guard in a patched leather jerkin, his knuckles bruised and his eyes half closed with boredom. A ring of iron keys hangs at his belt.

creatures.long_desc: A hulking stone troll squats in the gloom, its grey hide indistinguishable from the rock around it.
creatures.description: A troll built like a boulder, its skin cracked and pitted like granite and furred with moss. Its eyes are small and red, and its fists are the size of anvils.
rooms: The Great Altar Of The Eclipse

creatures.long_desc: A bloodied cultist priest chants low beside the altar, a curved blade raised in both hands.
creatures.description: A gaunt priest in a robe stiff with old gore, his face daubed with ochre and his hair matted with grease. His eyes burn with a fierce, glazed light.
rooms: The Quarters Of The High Priest
The Great Altar Of The Eclipse

creatures.long_desc: Grummash, the thicket beast, crouches over a heap of bones, huge and bristling, its hot breath rolling in clouds.
creatures.description: A monstrous thing of fur, thorn and muscle, bigger than a wagon, with tusks like sabres and a hide matted with briars. Old spear shafts jut from its back, and its small eyes burn.
rooms: The Lair Of The Thicket Beast

creatures.long_desc: Ulgrathar, the High Druid, stands at the Slaughter Stone with a sickle gleaming in his hand.
creatures.description: A tall druid in a cloak of black feathers and bark, his white beard braided with finger bones. Blood runs to his elbows, and the stones hum with his every word.

items.room_desc: A carved boar-tusk charm lies here.
items.description: A curved tusk, scratched with spirals and strung on a leather thong. Cultists wear them to mark a kill.

items.room_desc: A chipped stone maul lies here.
items.description: A slab of granite lashed to a stout oak haft with rawhide. It is heavy and brutal, and the head is pitted with old stains.
A dark green stone flecked with red, set in a ring of tarnished copper. It is warm and seems to pulse faintly against the skin.

items.room_desc: A thorny hide mantle lies here.
items.description: A shaggy cloak cut from the hide of a monstrous beast, still stiff with burrs and briars. It smells of the thicket and keeps out wind and rain.

items.room_desc: A moon-bright druid's sickle lies here.
items.description: A curved blade of pale metal with a handle bound in black feathers. The edge is keen and faintly hums, as the stones of the circle do.
